references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses was to overlay the incense altar with pure gold and make a gold crown around it. Exodus 37:26 describes the fulfillment of this command.
A parallel text giving God's command to overlay the incense altar with pure gold, including its top, sides, and horns, as well as to make a gold crown around it.
The same chapter describes how the ark of the covenant was overlaid with pure gold and given a gold crown around it, showing the consistent pattern in the holy objects of the tabernacle.
The table for showbread was also overlaid with pure gold and given a gold crown around it, demonstrating the same construction method for the sacred furniture of the tabernacle.
Solomon's temple had an incense altar overlaid with gold, continuing the tradition from the tabernacle of having holy objects covered in gold.
The book of Hebrews mentions the golden incense altar as part of the sacred furnishings of the tabernacle and confirms its significance in worship.
Command and fulfillment: The original instruction for the design of the table.
Same event: Details about the construction of the table for showbread.
